'''Bengt Olov Muthén''' is a [[psychometrician]] and Professor Emeritus at the Graduate School of Education & Information Studies, University of California, Los Angeles. He is a former president of the [[Psychometric Society]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Past, Present and Incoming Presidents|url=https://www.psychometricsociety.org/content/past-present-and-incoming-presidents|website=psychometricsociety.org|publisher=Psychometric Society|accessdate=7 March 2017}}</ref>
